summary: Static/code review of the newly added i18n additions for the Wallet Top-Up modal and the Crypto (Dyno Pay) Checkout modal. Verified that the `topup` block exists under `admin` in all three locale files (/app/frontend/src/locales/en.js line 1541, es.js line 1532, fr.js line 1532) and the `crypto` block exists in all three (en.js line 1487, es.js line 1478, fr.js line 1478). ES translations for admin.wallet/topup keys (topupHistory, walletTopUp='Recargar', walletBalance='Saldo de la billetera') and FR equivalents (topupHistory 'Recharges récentes', walletTopUp='Recharger') are present with meaningful non-key strings. Main agent already smoke-verified the ES wallet top-up modal rendering ('Recargar billetera', 'RESUMEN DE LA RECARGA', preview $50/$50/$100). Due to context/token limits I did NOT execute a fresh full Playwright pass on this iteration; relying on code review + main-agent smoke verification. No missing keys or raw dotted identifiers were spotted in the locale files. English baseline block is intact.
action_items: Recommend a next iteration to run a full Playwright verification of: (a) wallet-topup-modal fully rendering ES/FR strings on amount step, preview labels, PAY step; (b) crypto-checkout-modal + crypto-order-summary + generate button + pay panel + status timeline in ES/FR; (c) EN regression on both modals. This iteration's verification was limited to static locale review + trust of main-agent smoke test.
critical_code_review_comments: Locale key `admin.topupHistory.status` object appears both in ES and FR — good. Ensure locale files remain a single JS object per language (no duplicate keys like `renew`/`status`/`continue` shadowing under admin block, which already exist at multiple positions; JS keeps the last-declared value silently, which could mask translations. Consider splitting admin block into sub-namespaces (admin.essentials, admin.dns, admin.transfer) to avoid accidental key shadowing.

Confirmed there is no obvious untranslated string in the new topup block; but the wallet PAY step ('Send exactly', 'To this address', 'Check now', 'I've sent it') was not statically located in the topup/crypto locale blocks I inspected — main agent should ensure the pay-step keys live under admin.topup.pay.* and admin.crypto.pay.* in all three locales.

success_rate.frontend: not fully executed this iteration — static review only

To reach crypto modal: seed localStorage 'nw_cart_v2' with a domain item, navigate to /cart, click [data-testid='cart-pay-crypto-button']. Main agent smoke-verified ES wallet already; next agent should focus on FR wallet + ES/FR crypto modal and verify pay-step labels are translated (may need to inspect DynoPay live-read response).
